judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this motor imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the WRCC2023 MI-B recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
